limitations: The whats-new/local and whats-new/national endpoints ignore the page and size query parameters (verified: identical results for page=1..5, size=5..500); they return a small fixed 'recent changes' list only, so no true pagination exists on those endpoints.

local-coverage-final-lcds and local-coverage-articles return their entire result set in a single call with no page/size controls either; 'up to 100' was achieved by combining all real records from all 3-4 relevant endpoints for the source, de-duplicating by (document_type, document_id, document_version), and taking the 100 most recently updated by the API's own updated_on_sort/last_updated_sort field.

For 'cms', contractor_id was omitted, which per empirical testing returns an aggregate feed across ALL Medicare Administrative Contractors nationwide (Palmetto GBA, CGS, WPS, First Coast, Wellpoint, Noridian, Novitas, etc.), not a Noridian/Novitas-exclusive record, plus the genuinely contractor-independent NCA feed from whats-new/national/.

For 'novitas', the whats-new/local recent-changes feed returned 0 records for every real Novitas contractor_id found in /v1/data/contractor/ (331,332,333,334,335,336,337) at retrieval time -- Novitas simply had no local-coverage document change logged in that endpoint's short recent-activity window on 2026-09-17. Novitas activity data therefore comes entirely from local-coverage-final-lcds (71 total) and local-coverage-articles (117 total).

No authentication was ever required for whats-new/local, whats-new/national, or local-coverage-final-lcds. local-coverage-articles required a Bearer token, but that token is issued instantly and without credentials by the public, no-login /v1/metadata/license-agreement/ endpoint -- this is not a real access barrier.
